name: Cleanse Affliction

heightening.text: Attempt to counteracting the affliction if it is a disease or poison.
Attempt to counteracting the affliction if it is a curse, disease or poison.

entries: Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an afflictions on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteracting with each casting.
